channel.title: Chaotic News Network
channel.description: Unbiased. Unverified. Unhinged. Chaotic News is satire. All stories are made up.

item.title: Local “Agentic” Clock Says Task Will Be Done in 2 Minutes, Has Said So Since Tuesday
item.description: The $249 smart clock, sold as “an AI agent that also tells time,” has stopped telling time but remains extremely confident.

item.title: Man Offering to Buy Audiobook Rights to Your Fanfic Admits He Never Had a Studio, He Just Really Needed to Know How Chapter 47 Ends
item.description: The so-called producer had no studio, no microphone and no money. He did have a pillow taped to a closet wall and very strong opinions about the cliffhanger.

item.title: Local Man Swaps Four Cables, Restarts His Car Twice; CarPlay Connects the Moment He Pulls Into His Driveway
item.description: The 25-minute drive was spent in total silence. The connection lasted 11 seconds, which experts say is “honestly a personal best for CarPlay.”

item.title: Memory Prices Hit “Unprecedented” Levels as Area Teen’s 16GB Laptop Is Formally Appraised as a Family Heirloom
item.description: Grandma has already asked who gets it in the will. The laptop has a frog sticker, a cracked corner and a Y key that only works if you mean it.

item.title: Area Teen Learns Pressing the Side Button Twice Sends Calls to Voicemail, Immediately Uses Newfound Power on His Mom
item.description: The trick took four seconds to learn. The grounding is expected to last two weeks. The pizza is already gone.

item.title: Area Teen Spends 6 Hours Power Washing Barbie’s DreamHouse, Has Not Seen His Own Bedroom Floor Since August
item.description: The DreamHouse is now 100% clean. His room is 0% clean. “It’s different,” he explained. “There’s a percentage bar.”

item.title: Modders Finish Decade-Long Project While Area Teen’s Group Project, Also Started in 2016, Still Waiting on Kyle’s Slide
item.description: A volunteer team built a complete set of game tools in their spare time. Kyle has not opened the slideshow, but he did react with a thumbs up in 2019.

item.title: Pikmin Get Their Own National Holiday Before Area Teen Gets a Day Off for His Birthday
item.description: The tiny plant creatures now have a whole day. The teen has a math test. “Honestly, the little guys are cooking,” a vice principal admitted.

item.title: Every Wrong-Number Text Is Now Legally Required to Open With “Hi, Is This Jessica?”
item.description: Jessica has not been reached since 2019. The Guild of Accidental Texters says it will keep trying, mostly at night, mostly with sunsets.

item.title: Area Teen Spends 45 Minutes Choosing a Game to Play, Gives Up, Watches a Stranger Play It on YouTube Instead
item.description: The teen owns 312 games. He has finished four. Experts call this “extremely normal and also a cry for help.”

item.title: V-Bucks Enter Freefall as Item Shop Goes Free; Local Kid Who Saved Allowance for 3 Years “Not Okay Right Now”
item.description: Economists call it the worst crash in skin-based currency history. One 11-year-old investor has not left his beanbag since the announcement.

item.title: YouTube Bot Check Now Asking Humans to Prove They Are Not Big D Randy
item.description: The new check skips the traffic lights and asks one question. No adult has passed it yet, including people who are definitely not Big D Randy.

item.title: Area Teen Reports Scammer, Scammer Reports Feeling “Very Attacked”
item.description: After being screenshotted, reported and blocked in 94 seconds, a scammer filed a formal complaint about the “toxic environment” of people who refuse to be scammed.

item.title: “Steve From Microsoft” Asks Supervisor, Also Named Steve, for Help
item.description: The call center has 14 employees. All of them are named Steve. Productivity has collapsed, the printer is also named Steve, and none of them work at Microsoft.

item.title: Local Scam Account Blocked, Cries in Comic Sans
item.description: The account, which sent “hey cutie” to 4,000 people, released a tearful statement in yellow-on-red Comic Sans. Readers are struggling to take it seriously.

item.title: Bulgeet & Bibi Enterprises Website Still Has Zero Working Buttons, Inspectors Confirm
item.description: CN inspectors pressed all 41 buttons on the site. Every one of them pressed back with a popup congratulating them for nothing happening.

item.title: Big D Randy Takes Out Local AI With Name Alone, Never Even Has to Load
item.description: Witnesses say the skit character never had to speak, appear or buffer. The AI is in stable condition and still giggling.
